1) **Radar/Map Circle:** Yes. The radar circle is a **muted reddish-brown/dark red** dashed ring, and the center dot is **dark ink/white** (not bright purple).
2) **Distance Progress Bar:** No, it appears as a **muted dark grey/black** bar (not green).
3) **Check-in Button:** It has a **muted reddish-brown background** with white text and a shield icon.
4) **Any Purple?** **Yes**, there is a distinct **bright/lavender purple dot** inside the mini map widget in the top-right student profile card.
